eval: (() => { const g = game, p = g.player, V = p.position.constructor, cam = g.engine.camera; p.position.set(-29, g.terrain.heightAt(-29, -28), -28); p.velocity.set(0, 0, 0); p.yaw = 1.0; p.pitch = -0.08; g.chunks.warmup(p.position); p.update(1 / 30); cam.updateMatrixWorld(); const K = g.deer; for (const M of [g.boars, K]) { for (let i = M.active.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) M.release(i); M.frozen = true; M.spawnTimer = 1e9; } const e = cam.position, fx = -Math.sin(p.yaw), fz = -Math.cos(p.yaw), rx = Math.cos(p.yaw), rz = -Math.sin(p.yaw); const at = (side, dist) => new V(e.x + fx * dist + rx * side, 0, e.z + fz * dist + rz * side); const [albino, galheiro] = K.kind.rares; const a = K.spawn(at(-2.8, 9), p.yaw + Math.PI / 2 + 0.3, 1.05, albino.palette); a.rare = albino; a.pose('forage', 0); const gh = K.spawn(at(2.6, 10), p.yaw + Math.PI / 2 - 0.2, 1.32, galheiro.palette); gh.rare = galheiro; gh.state = 'alert'; gh.threat.copy(p.position); gh.update(0.5, K); gh.update(0.5, K); window.__rares = { a, gh }; g.spotAnimals(); return { aviso: document.querySelector('.hud-note').textContent, vistas: g.journal.view().seen }; })()
label: albino e galheiro à vista: entram no caderno

eval: (() => { const g = game, p = g.player, w = g.weapon, inp = g.input, V = p.position.constructor, cam = g.engine.camera; const gh = __rares.gh; const tgt = gh.zonePoint('chest', new V()); const e = cam.position; p.yaw = Math.atan2(-(tgt.x - e.x), -(tgt.z - e.z)); p.pitch = Math.atan2(tgt.y - e.y, Math.hypot(tgt.x - e.x, tgt.z - e.z)); if (!w.aimToggled) inp.buttonsPressed |= 4; for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) { p.update(1 / 30); w.update(1 / 30); inp.endFrame(); } g.hunting.lastShot = null; w.magazine = 5; inp.buttonsPressed |= 1; w.update(1 / 30); inp.endFrame(); for (let i = 0; i < 400 && !g.hunting.lastShot; i++) g.hunting.update(1 / 60); const r = g.hunting.lastShot; const v = g.journal.view(); return { tiro: r && { letal: r.lethal, pontos: r.points, dist: +r.distance.toFixed(1) }, aviso: document.querySelector('.hud-kill').textContent, linha: v.rows.find(x => x.name === 'Veado-galheiro'), maiorVeado: v.records.find(x => x[0] === 'Maior veado')[1] }; })()

eval: (() => { const g = game, p = g.player, V = p.position.constructor, cam = g.engine.camera; g.weapon.aimToggled && g.input.pressed; const sp = g.birds.speciesList.find(s => s.id === 'tucano'); g.birds.frozen = true; const e = cam.position; const fx = -Math.sin(p.yaw), fz = -Math.cos(p.yaw); const pos = new V(e.x + fx * 4.5, e.y - 0.1, e.z + fz * 4.5); const b = g.birds.spawnPerched(sp, pos, false, null); b.showcase(pos, p.yaw + Math.PI / 2, 0, 1); g.spotAnimals(); return { aviso: document.querySelector('.hud-note').textContent, vistas: g.journal.view().seen }; })()
